Gone Too Soon: 9 Lives Lost Across IITs, NITs & IISc

🕊️ 18 Days. 9 Lives Lost.

The IIT, NIT and IISc communities have witnessed a deeply painful series of tragedies in just 18 days.

3 suicides confirmed • 4 accidental deaths • 2 cases still under investigation.

Behind every number was a student, a professor, a friend, a child and a family whose lives will never be the same.

This post is not about numbers alone. It is about remembering the lives lost, supporting those who are grieving, and reminding our institutions that student and campus safety must always remain a priority.

May the departed souls rest in peace. 🕊️
Om Shanti. 🙏

Cases and circumstances are based on available reports; investigations remain ongoing in some cases.

PM Modi's IIT Delhi Speech Leaves Students With a Motivational Message 🎓

During his address at IIT Delhi, Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke to students about ambition, innovation, learning, and the opportunities ahead for India's young generation.

The speech touched on the importance of thinking beyond conventional limits, developing new ideas, taking risks, and using knowledge to create solutions for the future. He also emphasized the role that students and young innovators can play in shaping developments in technology, research, and entrepreneurship.

One of the notable aspects of the address was its focus on encouraging students to look beyond academic achievements and think about the wider impact of their skills and ideas.

The speech has since attracted attention online, with clips from the interaction being shared by students and viewers who found several of the messages inspiring and thought-provoking.

A speech focused on education, ambition and the possibilities that open up when young minds are willing to think bigger. 🚀
